notes:
## New features & enhancements

- **The manual is now the User Reference Guide.** `README.html` has been renamed to `User Reference Guide.html`, and the installer clears the old file away when it updates you.
- **Its search has been rebuilt.** It sits in the bar across the top, reads the whole manual rather than the headings, lists every section a word appears in with a count, and marks each hit on the page. The ✕ clears the search and the marks with it.
- The guide opens **taller** — 1000×1240, and never larger than the screen it opens on, so it still fits a laptop.
- A **back-to-top arrow** appears once you are a screen and a half down, and puts the page back in under a third of a second.
- The guide now opens the copy that is **actually on disk**. It is a local page in a named window, so it could be served from the cache — leaving you reading the manual for the version you had before the update.

## Bug fixes

- **8-bit:** the volume and tone sliders were still lighting part of a second LED. Exactly one lamp is lit now, and it is the same width as the unlit ones.
- The **update dot** on the Settings gear sat on top of the glyph instead of beside it. It is smaller, and in the corner.
